matches.tactical_summary: Ivory Coast displayed clinical finishing, converting their opportunities efficiently through Nicolas Pépé to secure the win. Curaçao struggled to penetrate the Ivorian defense consistently, despite creating some chances, and could not find the back of the net.

narrative: Ivory Coast secured a crucial 2-0 victory over Curaçao, with Nicolas Pépé netting both goals to confirm their progression to the Round of 32. This result solidified Ivory Coast's second-place finish in Group E, while Curaçao was eliminated from the tournament.
